speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a dermatological concern; can you describe the lesion's appearance, size, and how long it has been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Penis (with synchronous lesion on the finger).

The patient's history of heavy smoking, non-healing lesions in sun-exposed and mucosal areas, and failure of prior treatments for syphilis and eczema strongly suggests malignancy. I will now request a biopsy of the penile lesion for histopathological confirmation.
